audit.whatIsWrong: Sides read Heimerdinger / Skill x5 / Heimerdinger while this page's own whys say the opposite on five rows. The already-audited mirror ends on Skill / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Volibear / Skill / Volibear.
audit.why: whys[0] calls levels 1-2 a skill window, whys[2] and whys[3] describe Heimerdinger zoning you off CS, and whys[4] and whys[6] describe you diving him. The prose was right and the sides were stale. 46.7% over 227 games fits a lane you lose until 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-6: Skill / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Volibear / Skill / Volibear, ratings 5/6/3/3/7/6/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3] tells you to run him down at levels 4-5, which is the exact window the chart and the mirror both give to Heimerdinger.
audit.why: By 4-5 he has a turret line plus Hextech Micro-Rockets at 1325 range against your 300-range Q. Your spike is level 6, when Stormbringer leaps the line and disables the tower behind it.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 are his; level 6 is the flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED NAME: 'CH-3X Grenade' / 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' appears in breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[1].text and wants.foe[1]. The ability is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon slot E. The mirror found the same fabrication and noted it also appears in heimerdinger__trundle, so it is a repo-wide pattern rather than a one-off typo.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat, 970 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats the grenade as a stun you dodge entirely, and never says the splash is only a slow.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.' Only the direct hit stuns, so clipping the edge costs you movement speed, not your whole commit.
audit.corrected: Only the direct hit stuns — sidestep the centre and eat the splash.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Clear his turrets' is given as a do with no mention of how fast he replaces them.
audit.why: H-28 G Evolution Turret has a 1-second cooldown at 20 mana; clearing the nest buys seconds, not a lane. Mana, not cooldown, is what limits him.
audit.corrected: Turrets rebuild on a 1s cast — clearing them is a tempo play, not a solution.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Heimerdinger under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you inside the blast, but a full turret line plus 1325-range rockets out-range everything you have at 3. Farm it out.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Heimerdinger down every time CH-2 Grenade (Stun) is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the bite chunk hard, but his grenade is 11s flat and only the direct hit stuns — until 6 you cannot close on a full turret line.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Heimerdinger CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Lobs a grenade that slows, and stuns at the center. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: matchup-defining — 11s flat, 970 range; only a direct hit stuns, the splash just slows. - H-28 G Evolution Turret: 1s cooldown, so he rebuilds the nest instantly. - Micro-Rockets: 1325 range, 11s.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 11s flat, 970 range, and only the direct hit stuns — sidestep the centre.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in him.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11s at 970 range and only its direct hit stuns. Turrets rebuild on a 1s cast.

edits.before: Stormbringer (R) leap ignores his turret line and Q-stuns him — this is your first real kill window — but if he lands CH-3X Grenade (E) stun mid-leap he can flip the all-in and back off.
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) leaps past his turret line and disables the tower for the dive — but a direct CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) hit stuns you mid-commit, and it is only 11s.

edits.before: Land CH-3X Grenade (E) stun to cancel your dive
edits.after: Land a direct CH-2 Grenade (E) hit to stun you

notes: The 'CH-3X' fabrication is confirmed on this page and the mirror reports it also live in heimerdinger__trundle — worth a repo-wide grep for CH-3X outside this slice. Not asserted: whether Stormbringer's leap can be interrupted by the grenade stun once it is already travelling, or only before takeoff. Riot's text does not say and I did not guess; the rewrite says 'mid-commit', which is true either way.
